## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the RWD task ID.

## Implementation

Explain relevant package boundaries and contract changes. Identify any architecture, dependency, privacy, or recovery decision requiring Rasit's review.

## Validation

List commands run and results. Include UI evidence or failure-path tests when relevant. State any checks not run and why.

## Limitations

Document incomplete behavior and remaining risks. Keep unimplemented features clearly labeled.

- [ ] Required automated checks pass.
- [ ] Docs and runtime contracts match the behavior.
- [ ] Module owners have reviewed applicable changes.
- [ ] Rasit (@RXD3) has final technical/merge approval.
